hub.title: Project Showcase Hub
hub.subtitle: Engineering & Software Portfolio
hub.description: An interactive showcase of live applications, mobile systems, AI chatbot interfaces, and developer utilities.

projects.title: Banana Dashboard
projects.tagline: Modern responsive analytics and operations dashboard interface
projects.summary: High-performance operational dashboard featuring modern data visualization components, flexible grid cards, and adaptive dark/light layouts.
projects.fullDescription: Banana Dashboard is a web application designed for clear data presentation and streamlined task monitoring. It emphasizes accessibility, instant responsive adjustments across devices, and zero unnecessary script bloat for ultra-fast initial page loads.
keyFeatures: Lightweight, zero-overhead modular architecture
Responsive data grid with adaptive card layouts
Clean semantic HTML5 structure with custom CSS design tokens
Interactive KPI metric indicators and status chips

projects.title: SmashDash Court Booking
projects.tagline: Real-time sports facility reservation and court scheduling mobile app
projects.summary: Cross-platform mobile application providing seamless court booking, timetable slot reservations, and facility schedule coordination.
projects.fullDescription: SmashDash Court Booking simplifies athletic facility reservations for players and venue operators. Designed with Flutter and Dart, the application delivers smooth 60fps animations, intelligent conflict resolution for overlapping time reservations, and automated booking confirmations.
keyFeatures: Interactive venue calendar with live court slot availability
Optimistic booking mutation feedback with conflict prevention
Multi-venue support with location-based filtering
Mobile-first gesture navigation and smooth transitions

projects.title: Malaysia Travel Companion
projects.tagline: Interactive mobile travel exploration guide across Malaysia
projects.metrics: 🗺️ 13 States Covered • Offline Access • Curated Spots
projects.summary: Mobile travel discovery application helping tourists and locals discover destinations, cultural heritage landmarks, and curated itineraries.
projects.fullDescription: Malaysia Travel Companion bridges destination discovery with interactive travel planning. Users can explore top attractions, local food havens, historical sites, and regional itineraries with rich photo galleries and localized navigation routes.
keyFeatures: Curated travel destinations categorized by state and interest
Interactive route planning and estimated travel durations
Bookmark and offline favorites persistence
Modern card-based discovery feed with high-res visual assets

projects.title: Nuxt AI Chatbot
projects.tagline: Next-gen conversational AI interface with real-time streaming
projects.metrics: ⚡ Real-time Stream • Markdown & Code Highlight • Multi-Model
projects.summary: Full-stack AI conversation application powered by Vue and Nuxt featuring streaming text generation, syntax highlighting, and conversation history.
projects.fullDescription: Nuxt AI Chatbot demonstrates modern conversational UI engineering. Built with Nuxt and Vue, it handles asynchronous Server-Sent Events (SSE) token streaming, markdown rendering with syntax-highlighted code blocks, prompt history management, and responsive chat bubbles.
keyFeatures: Real-time streaming text generation via Server-Sent Events
Syntax highlighting for code snippets across 30+ languages
Thread persistence with editable conversation titles
Reactive state management and clean component architecture

projects.title: Portfolio Engine
projects.tagline: Automated developer portfolio generator and project showcase engine
projects.metrics: 🐍 Python Powered • Dynamic Generation • Fast Deploy
projects.summary: Automated data-driven project showcase and portfolio builder written in Python.
projects.fullDescription: Portfolio Engine processes structured project definitions to compile unified, performant portfolio showcases. It automates asset optimization, metadata tagging, and deployment artifact bundling.
keyFeatures: Automated data parsing and schema validation
Static page rendering pipeline
Extensible template system with custom theme hooks

projects.title: Java Object-Oriented Architecture
projects.tagline: Advanced design patterns and clean architecture implementations
projects.metrics: ☕ Clean Architecture • SOLID Principles • Design Patterns
projects.summary: Reference repository implementing core object-oriented software engineering paradigms and enterprise design patterns in Java.
projects.fullDescription: A structured Java codebase demonstrating practical applications of SOLID principles, polymorphic domain hierarchies, Creational/Structural/Behavioral design patterns, and unit-tested business logic.
keyFeatures: Complete implementations of Factory, Strategy, and Observer patterns
Robust encapsulation and interface-driven design
Comprehensive unit test coverage verifying business logic invariants

projects.title: SmashDash Core Platform
projects.tagline: Central platform services and facility management architecture
projects.metrics: ⚡ Modular Backend • API Gateway • Scalable Schema
projects.summary: Central platform infrastructure coordinating sports tournaments, court bookings, and member accounts.
projects.fullDescription: SmashDash Core provides the shared platform models and services supporting the SmashDash ecosystem. Focuses on robust data schema definitions, API contracts, and scalable backend workflows.
keyFeatures: Unified data contracts between mobile clients and admin portals
Court allocation and match scheduling engine
Modular service architecture ready for cloud scaling

projects.title: Continuous Delivery Test Suite
projects.tagline: Automated deployment verification and CI/CD validation pipeline
projects.metrics: 🚀 Automated Pipeline • Zero-Downtime Test • GitHub Actions
projects.summary: CI/CD testing pipeline repository demonstrating automated deployment triggers, test runs, and release artifact verification.
projects.fullDescription: A test bed for configuring and validating Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment pipelines. Explores automated build verification, environment promotion, and release health checks.
keyFeatures: Automated build and test workflow definitions
Branch protection and pull request validation gates
Environment smoke testing and deployment alerts
